title: Turán-type extremal problems for unbalanced signed graphs
summary: In this paper, we establish two Turán-type results for signed graphs. We first generalize the classical Turán theorem to signed graphs and then extend Nikiforov's spectral Turán theorem to signed graphs. Moreover, we determine the second maximum spectral radius among all unbalanced signed graphs that contain no balanced complete signed subgraph on \(r+1\) vertices.
